title: Ramification multiplicity in the supported Cartier purity comparison
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $s\geq1$ and $A=\mathbf Z/\ell^s\mathbf Z$. Let $X,X'$ be Noetherian regular affine schemes with $\ell$ invertible [def-weil-regular-scheme], let $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $g\in\Gamma(X',\mathcal O_{X'})$ be nonzerodivisors, and assume $D=V(f)$ and $D'=V(g)$ are regular. These are effective Cartier divisors [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Let $h:X'\to X$ satisfy $h^*f=g^e$ for an integer $e\geq1$. Write $i,i'$ for their closed inclusions, $j:X-D\hookrightarrow X$ and $j':X'-D'\hookrightarrow X'$ for the complementary opens, and $h_D:D'\to D$ for the induced map. Use ordinary small-etale derived module categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the finite Tate line $A(-1)$ dual to $\mu_{\ell^s}$ [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], and the ordinary supported Kummer classes [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. Put
$$K_D=\operatorname{fib}(A_X\longrightarrow Rj_*A_{X-D}),\qquad K_{D'}=\operatorname{fib}(A_{X'}\longrightarrow Rj'_*A_{X'-D'}).$$
The supported Kummer classes factor uniquely through these fibres and give isomorphisms $P_D:i_*A_D(-1)[-2]\xrightarrow{\sim}K_D$ and $P_{D'}:i'_*A_{D'}(-1)[-2]\xrightarrow{\sim}K_{D'}$. Let $\theta:h^*K_D\to K_{D'}$ be induced by the identity $h^*A_X=A_{X'}$ and the open direct-image exchange, i.e. the mate of the pullback square, with its actual unit normalization. Let $\rho:h^*i_*A_D(-1)\to i'_*A_{D'}(-1)$ be the closed exchange followed by reduction from $V(g^e)$ to $V(g)$ and the canonical Tate-line pullback. Then the following equality holds in $D(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A)$:
$$\theta\circ h^*P_D=P_{D'}\circ(e\,\rho)[-2].$$
In particular, the transition on the sole nonzero cohomology sheaf of the supported objects, in degree $2$, is $e$ times the closed Tate-line exchange. The formula includes empty divisors and $e=1$.
